title: net1 v4 grid: dropout and width on the broad dataset
description: net1 v4 on the broad dataset (releases exp-data-net1-broad-30s-5 and -60s-8): 3 x 2 grid over dropout and width, each a 3-member ensemble with net1 v3's other settings, ranked on validation rows; the chosen run is reported on test links, held-out controllers and the four held-out families (exp-data-net1-broad-ood-9), next to net1 v3.
run: uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/net1-d$DROPOUT-w$WIDTH" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set dropout=$DROPOUT --set width=$WIDTH --data "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "$IN/d60/campaign-train60" --ood competitors="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-competitors" --ood loss="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-loss" --ood rtt="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-rtt" --ood buffer="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-buffer" --compare "$IN/models/net1v3.pt"
